title: Order source on Create order
problem: Hand-made orders all looked the same, so nobody knew which came from Facebook, WhatsApp or phone.
now: Create order asks where the order came from, and All orders can be filtered by source.
steps: Create an order with source WhatsApp
Open All orders and press Search
notes: Where: Orders › Create order (/new-order); All orders › Search and filter › Source; app New order
